# A for Aesthetics

> A nurse-led, non-surgical aesthetics clinic in Sheffield, UK, led by Eleana — an Advanced Nurse Practitioner and independent prescriber. Natural-looking results, assessed and carried out by a nurse prescriber, always led by a free consultation.

A for Aesthetics is a small, personal clinic offering non-surgical aesthetic treatments across two Sheffield locations. Every treatment begins with a free, no-obligation consultation and is carried out to a medical standard.

## Key facts

- Practitioner: Eleana, Advanced Nurse Practitioner (ANP), NMC-registered nurse and independent prescriber, MSc Advanced Clinical Practice (Sheffield Hallam University), 8 years' experience, ACE accredited, fully insured.
- Rating: 5.0 on Google (64 reviews).
- Locations: A for Aesthetics at Peaches, 5 Wadsley Lane, Hillsborough, Sheffield S6 4EA; and A for Aesthetics at And Collective, 673 Abbeydale Road, Nether Edge, Sheffield S7 2BE.
- Areas served: Sheffield, Rotherham, Barnsley, Doncaster and Chesterfield.
- Phone: 07758 930674. Email: aforaesthetics@hotmail.com.
- Booking: https://facesconsent.com/v2/bookings/aforaesthetics-1833

## Treatments

- [Lip fillers](https://aforaesthetics.com/lip-fillers): Natural-looking definition, shape and hydration using dermal filler.
- [Dermal fillers](https://aforaesthetics.com/dermal-fillers): Restoring volume and structure to cheeks, chin, jaw, tear troughs and more.
- [Anti-wrinkle injections](https://aforaesthetics.com/anti-wrinkle-injections): Prescriber-led softening of frown, forehead and eye lines and other areas. A prescription-only treatment, assessed and prescribed in person.
- [Skin boosters](https://aforaesthetics.com/skin-boosters): Injectable hydration for smoother, better-quality skin.
- [Fat dissolving](https://aforaesthetics.com/fat-dissolving): Targeted treatment for small, stubborn pockets of fat.
- [Advanced treatments](https://aforaesthetics.com/advanced-treatments): The full range of advanced non-surgical options.
- [Prices](https://aforaesthetics.com/our-prices): Treatment price guide.
